notes: Veyra 0.5.1: memory now really saves and survives restarts (name, preferences, people) — learned automatically and reviewed after each chat; only a compact core goes into the conversation, the rest is searched when needed. Say 'band karo' / 'bye' to end the session. Screen typing replaces text and a new clear action empties fields without closing apps. Wake word uses less battery in noisy rooms, quieter notification, optional root 'hide mic dot'.
